title: Newton Method for Fixed-Support Doubly Entropic Wasserstein Barycenter
summary: We study the fixed-support doubly regularized Wasserstein barycenter problem. Using the semi-dual formulation of entropic optimal transport, we reformulate the problem as a smooth, unconstrained, convex optimization problem in the dual variables. We then derive explicit expressions for the gradient and Hessian and develop an exact Newton method for high-accuracy barycenter computation. To improve scalability, we propose a sparse Newton variant that sparsifies the transport probability matrices, thereby reducing the cost of Hessian-vector products.
